title: The Turnover Charge for a Large Party in a Resort Lodging Unit
content:
A turnover charge is added for a Resort Lodging party larger than the unit sleeps as standard, because the linen and the turnaround are worked out per bed. Two things are read together: the party recorded on the reservation, counting adults and children, against the unit type's standard and maximum occupancy; and whether the folio shows the party occupied more than one night.

Where the party recorded on the reservation fills the unit type's maximum occupancy and the folio shows the party occupied more than one night, the full turnover share of the unit type's housekeeping charge, being 30 percent of it, is added for each guest beyond its standard occupancy.

Where the party recorded is larger than the unit type's standard occupancy and the folio shows the party occupied more than one night, the half turnover share of that charge, being 15 percent of it, is added for each guest beyond the standard occupancy.

Where neither holds, nothing is added.

## The two occupancy figures of each unit type

| Unit type | Standard occupancy | Maximum occupancy |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Base Village Inn Room | 2 | 4 |
| Slopeside Studio | 2 | 4 |
| Slopeside One-Bedroom Residence | 4 | 4 |
| Slopeside Two-Bedroom Residence | 4 | 6 |
| Mountain Lodge Suite | 4 | 6 |
| Summit Penthouse Residence | 6 | 8 |
| Private Mountain Chalet | 8 | 12 |

### Three hypothetical stays in a Summit Penthouse Residence

The unit type's standard occupancy is 6 and its maximum occupancy is 8, and its housekeeping charge is taken here as 395.00 USD.

A party of 8 recorded on the reservation fills the maximum occupancy of 8; where the folio shows more than one night occupied, 118.50 USD is added for each of the 2 guests beyond the standard occupancy, being 30 percent of 395.00 USD, which comes to 237.00 USD.

A party of 7 is larger than the standard occupancy of 6 without filling the maximum; where the folio shows more than one night occupied, 59.25 USD is added for the 1 guest beyond the standard occupancy, being 15 percent of 395.00 USD.

A party of 8 on a folio showing only one night occupied answers neither, since both tiers require more than one night occupied, and nothing is added.
